title: WAKE UP AND PRAY THIS FIRST – YOUR ENEMIES ALREADY STARTED EARLY
text: Hallelujah. There is a staring in my spirit right now. Even before I say anything else, I sense that the Holy Spirit has been waiting for this moment. Lift your hands wherever you are. Don't rush. Don't analyze. Just lift your hands. I sense something very specific in the spirit. This is not a random moment. This is a window before 7:00 a.m. There are hours that respond to prayer differently. There are times when heaven is unusually attentive. If you are connected to this ministration, share it now, not later. Now, because there are voices that have been speaking against people all night and they about to be silenced. Father, Father, thank you for the privilege of the morning. Thank you because we woke up before the day woke up. Thank you because breath returned to us. Thank you because your mercy outpaced judgment. Thank you because the night could not finish us. We honor you now. Worship him gently. You are the ancient of days. The God who sits above time. The one whose voice breaks cedars. The one who shuts mouths without argument. We give you praise. You are holy. You are faithful. You are mighty. Morning star. Lion of Judah. The one who answers before we call. We adore you. Lift your voice softly and say, "Lord, take this morning." Yes, take it. Now listen carefully. There is a burden in my spirit. Not every attack comes with weapons. Some attacks come with voices, voices of accusation, voices of mockery, voices of limitation, voices speaking in the realm of the spirit. Zechariah 3:1 says, "He showed me Joshua, the high priest, standing before the angel of the Lord and Satan standing at his right hand to oppose him." And Satan didn't strike Joshua. He spoke. Revelation comes now. Many believers are fighting battles they cannot see because they are ignoring evil mouths. Psalm 109:2 says, "For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful have opened against me. They have spoken against me with a lying tongue. But listen, there is a higher mouth." Isaiah 54 17 says, "No weapon formed against you shall prosper, and every tongue which rises against you in judgment, you shall condemn." Not God will condemn. You shall condemn. This is authority. Before 700 a.m. is a strategic time. Why? Because many evil utterances are released before sunrise. But God has scheduled counter declarations. Now lift your right hand. Father, in the name of Jesus, we step into our authority now. Every mouth speaking against our lives, hear the word of the Lord be shut now in the name of Jesus. Open your mouth and pray. Every voice accusing me in the spirit be silenced now. Every word spoken to sabotage my day be canceled now. Every evil verdict released overnight be overturned now by the blood of Jesus. I decree and declare my name is cleared in the courts of heaven. Psalm 34 16 says, "The face of the Lord is against those who do evil to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth." Meaning some mouths are about to lose relevance. Now listen, I see someone. Your name is Daniel. There has been a pattern of people misjudging you. The Lord says, "I defend you this morning. Your voice will be heard correctly." Now lift both hands. We enter teaching by the spirit. Job 52 says, "He frustrates the devices of the crafty so that their hands cannot carry out their plans." Notice plans fail when mouths are shut. Many plans exist only because words sustain them. So this morning we are cutting the supply. Now pray again stronger. Every evil mouth assigned to delay my destiny shut now. Every tongue speaking sickness be silenced now. Every voice saying it will not work, lose your power now in the name of Jesus. Now tongues rise short sharponolita yam. Yes, I feel resistance breaking. Now hear this prophetic word. There is a woman here. Your name is mercy. People have spoken wrongly about you behind closed doors. The Lord says, "I reverse the narrative. Favor will speak louder. Now we escalate. Lift your voice." Psalm 64:es 2 says, "Hide me from the secret plots of the wicked, from the rebellion of the workers of iniquity who sharpen their tongues like a sword. Tongues can be swords, but swords can be disarmed. So pray, every sharpened tongue, be dulled now. Every lying report scatter now. Every spiritual gossip die now in the name of Jesus. I decree peace for your mind. I decree clarity for your day. I decree strength for your body. This is just the beginning. Father, we seal this first wave. We declare that before 7 a.m. every evil mouth is losing authority. Our day is protected. Our destiny is guarded in Jesus mighty name. Amen. Amen. Amen. I sense a holy anger in the spirit because some mouth speak not from emotion but from altars. Psalm 118 13 says you pushed me violently that I might fall but the Lord helped me. Meaning there are pressures designed to force failure but help is rising now. Listen carefully. Every evil mouth is sponsored by something. Words don't float on their own. They are powered. Isaiah 8 10 says, "Take counsel together, but it will come to nothing. Speak the word, but it will not stand. For God is with us." So this morning, we are not just shutting mouths. We are collapsing counsels. Lift your right hand. Father in the name of Jesus, every council formed against me before today, I scatter now. Every meeting held in darkness, be disrupted now. Every agreement reached against my destiny, be analled now in the name of Jesus, open your mouth and pray. Every satanic round table discussing my downfall, catch fire now. Every voice hired to c me, lose your assignment now. Every oracle speaking lies be struck silent now by the authority of Jesus Christ. Now hear this revelation. Witchcraft does not start with action. It starts with conversation. But Proverbs 21 23 says whoever guards his mouth and tongue keeps his soul from troubles. This morning God is guarding you by silencing other mouths. Now tongue short violent rabbakra sandalasha escarolita yamandesha yes I see something break now a word of knowledge there is a man here your name is Emmanuel a false report was about to move against you the lord says it dies before manifestation now we shift to family deliverance lift your voice Every evil mouth speaking against my family be shut now. Every generational voice saying this is how it ends. Be silenced now. Psalm 127 3 says children are a heritage from the Lord. Heritage is protected. So I decree your children will not be used as tools of sorrow. Your family will not be used as evidence of failure. Now pray every ancestral altar that speaks at dawn be destroyed now. Every bloodline cause activated by words break now in the name of Jesus. Now listen carefully. I see a woman your name is Abigail. There has been repeated marital misunderstanding felled by outsiders. The Lord says I silence interfering voices. Peace returns. Now we address finances. Lift your hands. Ecclesiastes 10 20 says, "Do not cause the king even in your thought. For a bird of the air may carry your voice." Meme meaning words affect wealth flows. So we pray every voice blocking my financial gates be silenced now. Every spirit saying you will struggle shut now. Deuteronomy 28 12 says, "The Lord will open to you his good treasure. I decree access unexpected provision. Help us with speed." Now tongues again deeper. Shakarabata lera kadoshay talimaron ketalra zataka yamanishes. Yes, I feel momentum building. Now listen, there is a man here. Your name is Joseph. You have faced mockery over a vision. The Lord says, "The mockers will watch it come to pass." Now we enforce divine preservation. Lift both hands. Psalm 91:4 says, "He shall cover you with his feathers." I decree covering, no backlash, no retaliation, no spiritual counterattack. Every evil mouth is not only shut, it is restrained. Father, we seal wave two. We declare that before 700 a.m. evil mouths are silent. Evil councils are broken. Evil altars are destroyed in Jesus mighty name. Amen. Amen. Amen. What is happening now is decisive warfare. This is where what resisted prayer begins to collapse under authority. I feel a strong weight in the spirit. Listen carefully. Some mouths don't speak audibly. They speak through symptoms. They speak through delay. They speak through repeated resistance. But today, before 7 a.m., every form of speaking is being shut down. Lift your hands. Psalm 107 20 says, "He sent his word and healed them and delivered them from their destructions. Healing comes by word. So sickness also speaks by word. But the higher word is speaking now. Father, in the name of Jesus, every sickness speaking against bodies, be silenced now. Every diagnosis that open its mouth, shut now. Every pain that keeps announcing itself, lose your voice now in the name of Jesus. Lay your hand where you feel weakness. I decree healing. Blood pressure normalized. Hormonal imbalance corrected. Chronic pain disappears. Isaiah 33 24 says, "No inhabitant will say, I am sick." Meaning sickness loses permission to speak. Now pray. Every infirmity programmed to speak before sunrise expire now. Every affliction with a voice be muted now by the power of Jesus Christ. Now tongue slow deep. Raaka Mones Rosha Selimando Zakarita Kivona. Yes, I sense heat and release. Now listen, I see a man, your name is Steven. You have battled chest tightness and fear in the mornings. The Lord says both the fear and the symptom are gone. Receive peace now. Now we move to destiny restoration. Lift your right hand. Psalm 57:2 says, "I cry out to God most high, to God who performs all things for me. Destiny is not self-powered. It is God performed. So pray. Every voice trying to rewrite my destiny be silenced now. Every prophecy of failure expire now. Every label spoken over my life be erased now. In the name of Jesus, I decree destiny alignment. Isaiah 46 10 says, "My counsel shall stand and I will do all my pleasure." God's pleasure is overriding human opinion. Now listen carefully. There is a woman here. Your name is Ruth. Your life took a detour that made people talk. The Lord says, "My original plan is restored. Speed comes." Now we enter witchcraft destruction. Lift your voice. Micah 52 says, "I will cut off witchcrafts from your hand and you shall have no soothsayers." Meaning their mouth goes silent when power is caught. So pray every witchcraft voice calling my name be silenced now. Every spell released by words break now. Every charm powered by incantation born now in the name of Jesus. Now tongues sharp authoritative raat ketalra sandapolicia yamanete escarados tabanom. Yes I see spiritual stat declared. Now hear this word. There is a young woman. Your name is faith. You have been battling sudden discouragement in the mornings. The Lord says the source has been caught. Yes. Say joy returns. Now we address time and virtue restoration. Lift both hands. Joel 2 25 says I will restore the years that the locust has eaten. Years talk. Regret talks but restoration speaks louder. So pray. Every voice reminding me of wasted time be silenced now. Every regret shouting in my mind. Quiet now in the name of Jesus. I decree restoration. I decree acceleration. I decree redemption of seasons. Now we prepare for the final seal. Lift your hands gently. Father, we thank you. Before 700 a.m., evil mouths are not just shut, they are judged. Before 700 a.m., our bodies are healed. Our destinies are aligned. Our households are preserved. Lift your hands again. Even if they are tired, lift them. Because what is happening now is irreversible enforcement. Listen carefully. There is a difference between prayer and verdict. Prayer asks, vict declares. And before 7 a.m. God authorizes verdict. Job 22 28 says, "You shall decree a thing and it shall be established for you and light shall shine on your ways." So now we are not negotiating, we are legislating. Lift your right hand. Father, by the authority of the risen Christ, we move from request to decree. Every evil mouth that survived earlier prayers, this is your end. Now open your mouth. I decree every mouth speaking failure over my life be short permanently. Every tongue programmed to announce bad news, lose breath now. Every voice speaking shame, delay, rejection, go silent now in the name of Jesus. Not tomorrow, not later, now. I feel resistance breaking again. Now listen, there are mouths that speak through people. There are mouths that speak through dreams. There are mouths that speak through thoughts. But all mouths bow to one authority. Philippians 2:es 9 to11 says God has highly exalted him and given him the name which is above every name that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow every knee includes every mouth. So lift your voice and say in the name of Jesus again in the name of Jesus now pray every negative dream voice be cancelled now. Every inner voice of fear be silenced now. Every external voice of discouragement lose influence now in the name of Jesus. Now tongues don't rush them. Let them rise. Calivones escarolita yamandesha raakata chandeli roster. Yes, something is being locked. Now hear this. I see a man. Your name is Victor. You've been mocked for standing in faith. The Lord says, "The mouths that mock you will soon ask questions. Now we enter family line enforcement. Lift both hands." Psalm 112:2 says, "His descendants will be mighty on earth. The generation of the upright will be blessed." So pray. Every mouth speaking backwardness into my bloodline be shut now. Every voice enforcing repetition of failure, break now. Every generational pronouncement not from God expire now. In the name of Jesus, I decree a new sound in your family, a sound of progress, a sound of favor, a sound of celebration. Now listen carefully. There is a woman here. Your name is Deborah. Your family has been labeled slow. The Lord says, "I remove the label. I know porting. Speed is restored." Now we go deeper. Some mouths speak in the courts of darkness. Zechariah 3:2 says, "The Lord rebuke you, Satan." Notice Satan was not debated. He was rebuked. So now we rebuke. Lift your voice. Every satanic prosecutor accusing me, be rebuked now. Every legal ground claimed against my life, be wiped off now. Every handwriting of ordinances nailed to the cross now. Colossians 2:14, I decree a quit. I decree clearance. I decree divine approval. Now tongues again stronger. Shakarabosata labra kadoshia talimar ketalra zatakisha yamania ravakuta celimarados. Yes I feel peace and authority together. That's a sign of victory. Now hear this word. There is a young man. Your name is Joshua. You were considering giving up quietly. The Lord says, "Your season is changing suddenly. Don't quit. Now we enforce day control. Lift your right hand." Psalm 118 24 again. This is the day the Lord has made. So say after me, they hear the word of the Lord again. They hear the word of the Lord. Now pray, "This day will not betray me. This day will not swallow my joy. This day will not produce tears. This day will favor me. This day will align helpers. This day will surprise me positively in the name of Jesus. We are not ending. We're still moving. I hear in the spirit maintain pressure because some doors don't open by noise. They open by consistency of authority. Psalm 66:3 says, "Say to God, how awesome are your works. Through the greatness of your power, your enemies shall submit themselves to you and on God, not negotiate, submit." Now listen, before 7:00 a.m. is not just a time, it is a deadline. Anything still speaking after this point is speaking illegally. Lift your right hand. Father, by the authority of the name of Jesus, we enforce compliance. Every evil mouth that refuse to shut, be forcefully silenced now. Every stubborn voice, be muted now. Every defiant tongue, lose permission now in the name of Jesus. Now open your mouth. I decree permanent silence. Permanent silence. Permanent silence. Not a pause. An end. I feel something collapse again. Now listen carefully. There are mouths that speak through patterns. Patterns of rejection, patterns of disappointment, patterns of sudden losses. But patterns are maintained by repetition of words. So now we break patterns. Lift your voice. Every negative pattern in my life, break now. Every cycle sustained by evil utterances, collapse now. Every repeating pain, stop now in the name of Jesus. Ecclesiastes 3:14 says, I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. So what God is doing now is permanent. Now tongue steady authoritative ramono zakaraa emro lash shadea. Yes. Now hear this word. I see a man. Your name is Paul. You were falsely blamed for something recently. The Lord says I declare your name openly. Truth will surface. Now we move to angelic reinforcement. Lift both hands. Psalm 103 20 says, "Bless the Lord, you his angels who excel in strength, who do his word, angels respond to spoken words." So now we speak, Father, release angels to enforce silence, angels to shut mouths, angels to block evil reports, angels to intercept negative messages in the name of Jesus. Now pray, angels of the Lord, go ahead of me today. Stand at my gates, stand at my doors, stand at my conversations, stand at my decisions. Let no evil word penetrate. Now tongues again. Shakatraiah zutapetanom. Yes, I feel guardrails forming around destinies. Now listen, there is a woman, your name is Lydia. You were anxious about a call or message. The Lord says that call will not carry bad news. Peace is restored. Now we enforce mind control because some mouth speak internally. Isaiah 26:3 says you will keep him in perfect peace whose mind is stayed on you. So pray every inner voice of fear be silence now. Every intrusive thought stop now. Every mental argument quiet now. In the name of Jesus I decree mental stillness, clarity, confidence. Now listen carefully. We are not ending. We are locking. Lift your hands slowly. Father, we lock this victory. We lock silence in the camp of the enemy. We lock favor in our hearts. We lock peace in our minds. We lock strength in our bodies. Every evil mouth is shut. Every good door is open. Before 7 a.m., the verdict stands. Still stay with me. No teaching now. No explanation. This is pure legislation. Lift both hands. I heard in the spirit enough has been said, now enforce. So we decree by the authority of the name above every name. I decree before 7 a.m. every evil mouth speaking against your life is short now. Not tomorrow, not gradually. Now I decree every tongue accusing you in secret loses its breath. I decree every voice predicting your failure is silenced permanently. I decree every word spoken to manipulate your emotions dies now in the name of Jesus. I decree that today will not carry bad news. I decree that no conversation today will harm you. I decree that no call, no message, no report will shake your peace. I decree divine control over your ears so you will not hear what you are not permitted to hear. I decree divine control over your mouth so you will not say what can trap you. I decree divine control over your steps so you will not walk into danger. Now lift your right hand higher. I decree any mouth assigned to cause your destiny is judged now. Any mouth hired to mock your progress is disgraced now. Any mouth programmed to release shame is shut by fire now. In the name of Jesus, I decree that the council of the wicked concerning you is frustrated. I decree that meetings held in darkness about you scatter now. I decree confusion in evil camps. I decree silence in satanic courts. I decree that your name is cleared. I decree that your image is restored. I decree that your helpers will hear the right voice and respond correctly. Now, tongue strong, authoritative. Yes. I decree destiny enforcement. I decree that no word spoken against your future will survive today. I decree alignment. I decree acceleration. I decree divine substitution where loss was planned. I decree that delays are canceled. I decree that shame is replaced with honor. I decree that what was whispered against you will be overturned publicly. Now listen carefully. I decree over your family, no evil mouth will speak death. No evil mouth will speak division. No evil mouth will speak sickness. Your household is sealed. Your lineage is defended. I decree over your finances. No voice will block your income. No tongue will scatter your resources. No word will drain your favor. Your gates are open. Provision flows. Help locates you. I decree over your health no symptom will speak again. No pain will announce itself. No weakness will dominate you. Your body aligns with the word. Now tongues again short final busts. Rabatash ketra sandor zutapia yamete escaradoshan lakutasha kiva. Yes. Now I seal by decree. I decree that the siege is over. I decree that every evil mouth is permanently shut. I decree that today answers to God. I decree that this week carries your testimony. I decree that your destiny is preserved. I decree peace. I decree favor. I decree victory in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Amen. Amen. Amen. We are ending it with authority, not emotion. Lift your hands one last time. What happens now is closure in the spirit. Not a pause, not a break, a finish. I hear clearly in my spirit. It is settled. So listen carefully. There are moments when God allows prayer to continue and there are moments when God says enough now walk. This is that moment. Psalm 20:6 says, "Now I know that the Lord saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand." And then two, meaning the answer has already left heaven. So now we seal, father, in the name of Jesus Christ, we stand on finished victory by the authority of the blood of Jesus, we issue the final verdict. Every evil mouth raised against these lives is shut forever. Not temporarily, not conditionally, forever. Every voice of accusation silenced. Every tongue of delay cut off. Every mouth of shame closed. Every word of manipulation voided. I decree that today will not hear your name in the camp of darkness. I decree that no evil report will locate you. I decree that no sentence spoken against you will survive the daylight. Isaiah 41 11 says, "Behold, all those who were incensed against you shall be ashamed and disgraced. They shall be as nothing, and those who strive with you shall perish." So I decree disappearance, disappearance of opposition, disappearance of resistance, disappearance of hidden enemies. I decree that what pursued you quietly has lost your address. Now listen, I decree peace that does not need explanation. I decree favor that speaks without introduction. I decree speed without struggle. I decree accuracy in decisions. I decree safety in movement. I decree that your steps today are ordered. I decree that helpers recognize you. I decree that doors open without argument. I decree that your body responds to life. I decree that your mind stays clear. I decree that your spirit stays sensitive. I decree that your destiny stays preserved. I decree that your family stays covered. I decree that your future stays protected. Now tongues slow victorious sealing tongues shakarosata leadosh talimar ketalra zatakia yam raakuta escarolita yamandesha. Yes I seal this by prophetic authority. The siege is over. The voices are silent. The doors are open. The path is clear. Walk into favor. Walk into peace. Walk into testimony. Before this week ends, you will say, "God defended me." In the mighty matchless name of Jesus Christ. Amen. Amen. Amen. Go now.
